vLLM local provider routes requests via vllm/ model prefix with no auth

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"vllm/meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
debugPrint(result.model())
```
